section_summary.extract_value: This section details the method for a single study (referred to as Study X). Participants included 39 undergraduate students with a mean age of 20.1 years. The procedure involved participants creating a collage within 18 minutes, followed by completing a questionnaire that included the Creativity Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ). Collages were then evaluated for creativity and aesthetic appeal by five local artists.
